title: Sleepy jellyfish
svg:

      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd6f2'/>

  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M47 51 Q50 54 53 51' fill='none' stroke='#6b2568' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M76 20 L84 20 L76 28 L84 28' fill='none' stroke='#a5e8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M86 10 L91 10 L86 15 L91 15' fill='none' stroke='#a5e8ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
